[tp-asciidoc-viewer%allow-script,label="tp-tabs"]
========
[script,type="tp/asciidoc"]
----
.Basic usage
======
[tp-tabs]
====
Tab 1::
+
Content of panel [tp-icon,size="2em",name="numeric-1"]#numeric-1#

Tab 2::
+
Content of panel [tp-icon,size="2em",name="numeric-2"]#numeric-2#

Tab 3::
+
Content of panel [tp-icon,size="2em",name="numeric-3"]#numeric-3#

Tab 4::
+
Content of panel [tp-icon,size="2em",name="numeric-4"]#numeric-4#
====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/icon/icon.js";
import "/components/tabs/tabs.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-tabs");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n        "));

const element2 = document.createElement("dl");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element3 = document.createElement("dt");
element3.append(document.createTextNode("Tab 1"));
element2.append(element3);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element4 = document.createElement("dd");
element4.append(document.createTextNode("Content of panel "));

const element5 = document.createElement("tp-icon");
element5.setAttribute("size", "2em");
element5.setAttribute("name", "numeric-1");
element4.append(element5);
element2.append(element4);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element6 = document.createElement("dt");
element6.append(document.createTextNode("Tab 2"));
element2.append(element6);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element7 = document.createElement("dd");
element7.append(document.createTextNode("Content of panel "));

const element8 = document.createElement("tp-icon");
element8.setAttribute("size", "2em");
element8.setAttribute("name", "numeric-2");
element7.append(element8);
element2.append(element7);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element9 = document.createElement("dt");
element9.append(document.createTextNode("Tab 3"));
element2.append(element9);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element10 = document.createElement("dd");
element10.append(document.createTextNode("Content of panel "));

const element11 = document.createElement("tp-icon");
element11.setAttribute("size", "2em");
element11.setAttribute("name", "numeric-3");
element10.append(element11);
element2.append(element10);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element12 = document.createElement("dt");
element12.append(document.createTextNode("Tab 4"));
element2.append(element12);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n          "));

const element13 = document.createElement("dd");
element13.append(document.createTextNode("Content of panel "));

const element14 = document.createElement("tp-icon");
element14.setAttribute("size", "2em");
element14.setAttribute("name", "numeric-4");
element13.append(element14);
element2.append(element13);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n        "));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n      "));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
